text:
Ravi (CS): Heads-up: Adele's private deployment dry run hit two blockers during the acceptance test. Posting thread for quick triage before we escalate to renewal review.

Adele (Customer): thanks — ran the onboarding playbook this morning. KMS unwrap failing and audit sink not receiving events.

Carlos (Infra): saw KMS:AccessDenied during key unwrap: 

```
2024-06-02T09:14:12Z ERROR KMS AccessDenied: Caller arn:aws:sts::987654321098:assumed-role/redwood-deploy-role is not authorized for kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:123456789012:key/ff11-22aa
```

Carlos (Infra): Looks like key policy missing cross-account allow. Adele, did you attach the policy to the CMK or just the alias?

Adele (Customer): I updated an alias policy earlier. Going to patch the key policy now.

Nina (NetEng): On the audit side, our test events to logs-us-west.redwood.io:443 were RST because of an outbound proxy rule. Your security team has an egress proxy that requires SNI allowlist. Can we get the proxy FQDN added?

Adele (Customer): proxy team needs the SNI hostnames. Do you have the exact hosts we use?

Priya (Platform): For audit delivery use these hosts: logs-us-west.redwood.io and metrics-us-west.redwood.io. If SNI can't be applied, open 52.14.88.99:443 as fallback.

Ravi (CS): Risk note: customer renewal touchpoint in 10 days; if cutover slips we need to flag finance and ops. Try to keep this a same-day fix.

Adele (Customer): I've added the principal to the CMK policy and gave Nina's role testing rights. Re-testing now.

InfraBot: ci/checks: kms-unwrap-test FAILED (AccessDenied) at 2024-06-02T09:16:45Z

Carlos (Infra): Still failing for our assumed-role. Adele, can you paste the key policy statement you added?

Adele (Customer): pasted: 

"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/redwood-deploy-role"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]

Carlos (Infra): That principal is our staging role account (987654321000). Our prod deploy role is in 987654321098. Need that exact ARN.

Adele (Customer): ah ok, fixing to 987654321098 now.

Nina (NetEng): On the proxy config, proxy team added logs-us-west.redwood.io to the SNI allowlist. I still see tcp reset for metrics host — can Adele confirm the fallback IP is allowed?

Adele (Customer): allowed 52.14.88.99 now.

InfraBot: ci/checks: kms-unwrap-test PASSED at 2024-06-02T09:21:30Z

Carlos (Infra): KMS unwrap success. Replaying queued key unwraps, looks good.

Priya (Platform): Audit sink now accepting events; I see delivery rate increase and no 4xx responses.

Ravi (CS): Great. Action items and notes: 1) Adele to confirm CMK ARN in onboarding checklist (avoid alias-only note). 2) Add prod vs staging principal examples to KMS template. 3) Update playbook to include SNI hosts and fallback IP. 4) Capture renewal risk as low now but we'll monitor for 48h.

Adele (Customer): will add CMK ARN to checklist and acked the item. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Priya (Platform): Logging feedback to internal onboarding repo: created issue #CS-894 with the doc changes and sample policies.

Ravi (CS): Closing the loop: final acceptance ran and passed. I'll update the account healthboard and mark renewal risk as low/monitoring. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
